text:
miriam_cs: Quick sync — reopening the AtlasSearch preview waitlist to add 20 more seats. We'll do priority invites (1: high-touch enterprise, 2: active trial, 3: general). Need final priority tags from CSMs by EOD.
kevin_onboard: Copy. Can you share the CSV export and the priority rubric? I'll reserve calendar slots for high-touch customers.
miriam_cs: Export: https://tiny.redwood/atlas-waitlist-export (please use the 'priority' column). Rubric: enterprise = renewals < 90 days OR exec sponsor; active trial = >= 5 queries/day last week; general = everyone else.
onboard-bot: Waitlist import complete: 20 new entries at 2024-11-03T07:22:11Z. file: atlas_waitlist_20241103.csv
eli_success: Heads-up: mark accounts with renewal windows in Q1 as 'enterprise' even if low usage — sales needs visibility.
jess_sales: Please do that — I'll annotate 4 accounts that are renewal-risk. Thanks.
priya_novacorp: Priya here — NovaCorp confirmed they want a recording if team can't make live. Is that an option? :raised_hands:
miriam_cs: Yes — we'll record sessions and upload to the cohort folder. But recordings won't replace the 15-min follow-up pulse; we need the survey for qualitative feedback.
tina_prod: Suggestion: include a short A/B script in wave invites to test default vs. fuzzy-match on a subset (wave 3). Keep waves 0-2 focused on baseline telemetry.
kevin_onboard: Noted. For logistics: high-touch invites = 90min workshop + 30min Q&A. Active-trial = 45min walkthrough. General = 30min demo + self-serve materials.
alan_ops: Ops on-call for the week of 11/10: Alan (9am-6pm PT). I'll monitor ingestion errors and join live for high-touch sessions. DM for cell.
onboard-bot: Reminder: upload deadline for sample datasets = 2024-11-08T23:59:00Z.
eli_success: Metrics we'll track: weekly_active_users, avg_queries_per_user, median_latency, precision@10. I'll add dashboards and a 'beta_engagement' alert set for WAU < 6 for 14d.
miriam_cs: Can we also flag churn risk if WAU drops 60% week-over-week? Sales needs early heads-up.
jess_sales: Yes please. Escalate to #customer-health + assign to me and Sam when triggered.
sam_success: I'll own the renewal follow-ups and capture blockers in a triage doc (JIRA link will follow).
kevin_onboard: I'll send calendar invites today and include the prep checklist + upload path. Template: https://tiny.redwood/atlas-invite-template
priya_novacorp: Appreciate it. One more Q: if ingestion fails during the session, is there a playbook for rollback or reindex?
alan_ops: Yes — runbook in the roster folder. Short flow: stop job -> clear partial index -> restart with debug logs -> notify support SLA channel. I'll paste the snippet in the folder.
miriam_cs: Ownership recap: priority tagging (CSMs & Jess), invites & recordings (Kevin), ops on-call (Alan), metrics & alerts (Eli), renewal follow-up (Sam). I'll do a final pass on the waitlist before invites go out.
kevin_onboard: Invite batch 1 scheduled for 11/11, high-touch accounts first. I'll ping once invites go out. :thumbsup:
priya_novacorp: Thanks team — NovaCorp prefers Tue 11/11 9:30am PT if that slot is available.
miriam_cs: Noted, I'll slot them in.
eli_success: Added a post-session quick survey (5 Qs) + a 30-day usage check. We'll track responses in the cohort sheet.
kevin_onboard: All set on our end. Will share the calendar + recording link after each session.
jess_sales: Thanks — I'll monitor any renewal-risk flags and coordinate with Sam for outreach.
onboard-bot: Thread closed by onboard-bot at 2024-11-04T18:45:00Z.
